title: Oklahoma 24, Alabama 3: First SEC Home Win, Nov. 23, 2024
question: What was the score when Oklahoma beat No. 7 Alabama on November 23, 2024?
answer: Oklahoma beat No. 7 Alabama 24-3 in Norman on November 23, 2024. It was the Sooners' first home win as an SEC member and made them bowl eligible.
summary: On Nov. 23, 2024, unranked Oklahoma stunned No. 7 Alabama 24-3 in Norman, the Sooners' first SEC home win and the win that clinched bowl eligibility.
body: Oklahoma entered its final home game of 2024 at 5-5 overall and 1-5 in the SEC, a rough first season in its new league. Alabama arrived in Norman ranked No. 7 at 8-3 and still hunting a College Football Playoff spot. Few expected the Sooners to threaten the Crimson Tide on Senior Night.

The game turned on the ground and on takeaways. Alabama led 3-0 after a first-quarter field goal, but Zane Schmit tied it before halftime, and true freshman running back Xavier Robinson scored from 18 yards out with 37 seconds left in the second quarter to make it 10-3. Robinson finished with a career-high 107 rushing yards and two touchdowns, according to the Associated Press.

Early in the second half, Eli Bowen intercepted Jalen Milroe, and Robinson punched in a one-yard score to make it 17-3. Linebacker Kip Lewis then picked off Milroe and returned it 49 yards for a touchdown with 8:05 left in the third quarter, putting Oklahoma ahead 24-3. Quarterback Jackson Arnold added about 131 rushing yards and went 9 of 11 through the air as the Sooners controlled the clock.

The result gave Oklahoma its first SEC home victory, lifted the team to 6-5 and made it bowl eligible. Alabama, which threw three interceptions, saw its playoff hopes badly damaged. Fans rushed the field late, and the win eased pressure on head coach Brent Venables after a difficult season.
